findings.location: HTML, poem, first and second stanzas
findings.source_quote: “Arise be glad! … Rejoice and sing! … Give thanks and laud” and “Arise and glorify the Lord! … Adore and praise our mighty Lord!”
findings.suggested_fix: For consistent address to a group, use plural imperatives throughout: in the first stanza change “Sorgi” to “Sorgete” and “Gioisci e canta” to “Gioite e cantate”; in the second stanza change “Sorgi” to “Sorgete” and “Adora” to “Adorate”.
findings.translation_quote: “Sorgi, sii lieto! … Gioisci e canta! … Rendete grazie” and “Sorgi e glorifica il Signore! … Esaltate … Adora e loda”
